verdict.rationale: Otter.ai is an enterprise meeting-transcription SaaS, so admin retention and deletion controls are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no scheduled auto-delete policy and no admin-initiated permanent erasure. The closest items are audit trails, activity logs, and keeping data out of AI model training, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit. A community report of a GDPR deletion request going unanswered is not evidence of a documented deletion capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set retention policies — auto-delete transcripts and recordings on a schedule — and permanently erase data on demand
